title: Nasruddin and the Well Bucket
summary: Watching the two wooden buckets of the village well, Nasruddin noted: "How like human fortune! When one bucket plunges into the dark depths, the other rises to the sunshine brimmin...
full_text: Watching the two wooden buckets of the village well, Nasruddin noted: "How like human fortune! When one bucket plunges into the dark depths, the other rises to the sunshine brimming with sweet water. Be patient in the depths, for your turn to rise is coming!"
moral: When one goes down, the other comes up; balance keeps the well of life flowing.
